question: How does knowledge produce dispassion even toward pleasure?
premises: Through knowledge one may become dispassionate even toward pleasure.
Knowledge clarifies this and that as they are.
The teacher has instructed this in many ways in his own teaching.
inference: True dispassion arises from knowledge, as the teacher repeatedly taught.
plain_english: Through knowledge one can become dispassionate even toward pleasure, discerning 'this is this'; for the teacher has taught this in many ways in his own scripture.
